snippet.title: Orion Sandbox 2 - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Orion Sandbox 2 brings you back to the universe of Orion Sandbox Enhanced. Only now it's bigger, more varied, and crazier than ever! New biomes, planets, dungeons, dangerous enemies, and endless possibilities for creativity await. Oh, and co-op for up to 4 players!

Build... well, anything! And go... well, anywhere! Ancient ruins? Another planet? It's entirely up to you what to do and where to head next.

Wishlist now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4337890/Orion_Sandbox_2/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=announcement

Explore. Build. Craft. Survive. Together.
#OrionSandbox2 #SandboxGame #IndieGames #Crafting #CoopGaming
